en: A black‑and‑white night photograph of a city square with wet, reflective pavement. On the left stands a multi‑story building with shuttered windows and a brightly lit corner shop bearing the illuminated sign 'JULIUS MEINL'. Street lamps light the open plaza extending into the distance. Along the bottom margin is a printed caption in German identifying the scene as the main square viewed from Schmiedgasse in Graz at night.
